scheme_name: Chief Minister Specially Abled Samman Pension Scheme
other_conditions: Applicant must have at least one of the following disabilities: blindness, short‑sightedness, locomotor disability, leprosy‑free, hearing loss, mental retardation, mental illness, dwarfism (height less than 3 ft 6 in with a medical certificate), or eunuchism
Must be a native of Rajasthan and residing in Rajasthan
benefits_summary: Monthly pension ranging from Rs. 750 to Rs. 1,500 depending on age and disability, with higher amounts for older beneficiaries and leprosy‑free persons
